title: DC-area forecast: Warmer and wonderful through at least Friday; weekend rain?
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Clear through the night as temperatures fall to lows mainly in the 50s.

What’s next? Another beauty tomorrow as we trend a bit warmer, then cooler and nice again Friday. Most of Saturday should be nice enough before rain could arrive late Saturday or on Sunday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Skies remain clear as evening readings quickly fall back into and through the 60s. Not as chilly as last night with lows in the upper 40s to mid-50s. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Thursday): Sunny skies keep a strong grip as we warm up to afternoon highs in the mid-70s to near 80 in the wake of a weak front. Humidity remains very comfortable with dew points in the 50s, falling to the 40s late. Perhaps a bit breezier than today, with wind out of the west near 10 to 15 mph. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Somewhat cooler air trickles in by evening. Skies stay mostly clear with overnight lows ranging from the upper 40s to mid-50s. Confidence: High

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Mostly sunny and cooler Friday, with highs in the low to mid-70s and light winds from the northwest. Friday evening readings cool through the 60s into the 50s, followed by overnight lows in the upper 40s to mid-50s. Confidence: High

Saturday probably starts mostly sunny. If and when we see increasing clouds depends on how quickly moisture from the remnants of a tropical system developing in the Gulf of Mexico this week approach from the south. Highs should be in the low to mid-70s again. Confidence: Medium

Rain could arrive as early as Saturday night or as late as Sunday afternoon, assuming the tropical system makes it this far north. Either way, Sunday is probably a cloudier day with highs aiming for the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for October 7

Torrential rain in 2005 set a daily record and, combined with the following day’s deluge, quickly erased a severe September drought.

Today’s daily digit — 10/10: Legit candidate for nicest day of the year! Sunshine and Goldilocks highs in the low 70s. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
